translation.name: Dillꞌ wen dillꞌ   Kob C̱he   Jesucrístonaꞌ

content: Wlejgake' gall beṉ' gak lall' nagake' mandadka'

Na' ka zej chanch beṉ'ka' chonḻilall' Jesúza', beṉ'ka' chṉe dill' griegona' wzolo che'gake' aga chaklebi ikaa noolə wizebka' chṉe dill' griegona' ka to daa chkaa nool wizebka' chṉe dill' hebrewa' kat' chyisgake' yeḻ' wawa' yog' lla.
Na'ch postlka' shlliṉ bti'agake' yog' beṉ'ka' chonḻilall' Jesúza', na' che'gake': ―Bi gak wsannto' c̱hix̱je'nto' cho'a xtill' Chioza' kwenc̱he kooz lo nanto' we'nto' dii yeej gao beṉ'.
Na' le' beṉ' bish', ḻi kwej gall beṉ' ladjleni, beṉ' chon wen, beṉ' chajnii, na' chṉabia' Espíritu Sántona' ḻegake'. Na' gak lall' na'gake' c̱hisgake' yeḻ' wawa'.
Na' neto' we'ḻ-lall'chnto' we'ḻwillnto' Chioza' na' wli' wsedchinto' beṉ' cho'a xtilleena'.

Na' yog'z beṉ'ka' biyoolall'gake' ka goll postlka', na' wlejgake' beena' le Esteban, nake' beṉ' nonḻilall'chgue' Chioza' na' chṉabia' Espíritu Sántona' ḻe'. Na' ḻekzka' wlejgake' Felípena', Prócorona', Nicanora', Timónna', Parménaza', na' Nicoláza', beṉ' Antioquíana', beena' bene' txen beṉ' Israelka'.
Na' jwa'gake' ḻegake' gana' lle' postlka', na' postlka' bx̱oa neeka' yic̱hje'ka' na' wṉabgakile' Chioza' gaklene' ḻegake'.
Na' beṉ' zanch beni cho'a xtill' Chioza' na' wyanchga beṉ'ka' benḻilall'gake' Jesúza' Jerusalénna', na' zan bx̱ozka' bzenaggake' na' benḻilall'gake' Jesúza'.
Na' Estébanna', wzoalenchga yeḻ' wak c̱he Chioza' ḻe', na' dii xen goklene'ne' kwenc̱he bli'e yeḻ' wakka' na' bichlə dii chonan ka yibani beṉ'.

Na'ch lle' shkwen beṉ' Israelka' ba biyell bila' lo na' beṉ'ka' wxi' ḻegake', na' non c̱heləgake' chdop chllaggake' gana' choe'ḻwillgake' Chioza'. Na' gokgake' toz baḻ beṉ' Cirene, beṉ' Alejandría, beṉ' Cilicia, na'ch beṉ' zaak do Ásiana', gokdiḻ-lengake' Estébanna'.
Na' aga gokgake' yeḻ' sin' c̱he Estébanna', daa chṉie' kon ka che' Espíritu c̱he Chioza'ne'.
Na' wdixjgake' baḻ beṉ' kwenc̱he wxiye'gake', che'gake': “Ba beninto' Estébanna' chṉie' zban c̱he dii Moiséza' na' c̱he Chioza'.”
Na' daa gollgake' ka', bta bṉegake' beṉ' zan, len beṉ' golka' chṉabia' na' beṉ'ka' chli' chsedi leya' kwenc̱he bex̱'gake' Estébanna' na' jwa'gake'ne' lao beṉ'ka' chṉabia' beṉ' Israelka'.
Na' wdiljchgake' beṉ'ka' wxiye', kwenc̱he gollgake': ―Bi chsankzə beeni iṉie' c̱he yoodo' c̱he Chios c̱hechona', na' c̱he ley c̱he'na'.
Na' ba bizeninto' chizne' Jesús, beṉ' Nazareta', yic̱hiṉje' yoodo' c̱hechona' na' yisha'tie' daa ba yoolocho choncho ka daa bli' bsedi dii Moiséza' cho'.
Na' yog' beṉ'ka' chi' chongake' yeḻ' josc̱hisa', ka bwiagake' Estébanna' na' ble'gakile' chey cheeni' cho'alawe'na' ka cho'alao anjl.
